subject: Dedicated capacity sizing: alignment on ETA, quotes, and cloud fallback
messages:
From: Alicia Park <alicia@acme.ai>
To: karthik_iyer <karthik@redwood.ai>
Cc: lauren_bishop <lauren@redwood.ai>
Date: 2025-08-21T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Sizing ask + tentative timeline for Dedicated pool

Hi Karthik,

Thanks again for the demo last week. We have a fast-moving product milestone in Q4 and need a Dedicated pool sizing estimate and rough ETA to inform our procurement committee. Ballpark ask is 200 A100-equivalent GPUs, with a ramp to 400 over 9 months depending on performance.

Can you confirm: 1) how long the procurement-onramp takes for a Dedicated pool with a committed monthly baseline, 2) whether Redwood can broker OEM quotes or if we should go direct, and 3) short-term cloud burst options until physical hardware is provisioned?

Appreciate a short runbook we can share internally.

Thanks,
Alicia
VP Product, Acme AI
[Attachment: proposal_outline.docx (DOCX, 24KB)]

From: karthik_iyer <karthik@redwood.ai>
To: Alicia Park <alicia@acme.ai>, Tim Chen <tim.chen@omnigpu.com>
Cc: lauren_bishop <lauren@redwood.ai>, ben_carter <ben@redwood.ai>
Date: 2025-08-21T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Sizing ask + tentative timeline for Dedicated pool

Alicia — looping in Tim from OmniGPU and copying Lauren/Ben on capacity and sales motion. Quick summary of next steps below; full answers in follow-ups.

High-level answers:
- Procurement-to-provision for dedicated racks (OEM-sourced) typically 12–20 weeks once the order is finalized, depends on SKU and customs.
- Redwood can introduce and coordinate with select OEM partners (like OmniGPU) and cloud burst partners (CloudEx) to provide a hybrid runway.
- We will produce a short runbook with three scenarios (fast, medium, conservative) tying commit levels to delivery cadence.

Tim — can you attach a draft quote and earliest ETA for a 200 -> 400 tranche? Ben, can you outline the cloud burst costs and minimum lead time with CloudEx? I can map scenarios to Acme's ramp.

Karthik Iyer
Senior Sales, Redwood Inference
[Attachment: redwood_capacity-sizer_v1.xlsx (XLSX, 48KB)]

From: Tim Chen <tim.chen@omnigpu.com>
To: karthik_iyer <karthik@redwood.ai>, Alicia Park <alicia@acme.ai>
Cc: lauren_bishop <lauren@redwood.ai>
Date: 2025-08-22T08:47:00-07:00
Subject: OmniGPU preliminary quote and lead times (200 -> 400)

Karthik / Alicia — Thanks for the intro. Sketching ETA and constraints below; attached is a fast-quote you can use internally (price validity: 21 days).

Summary:
- SKU: Omnibox A100-80GB equiv (quantization/slots depend on final config)
- Available to ship: earliest pick in our Q4 slot — 14 weeks from PO for initial 200 units.
- Ramp to 400: additional 8–12 weeks after initial shipment depending on production cadence.
- Key constraints: component supplier lead times (power modules), and customs clearance in US ports — recommend splitting shipments across two batches to reduce customs bottlenecks.

We can hold a provisional allocation for Acme with a 30% deposit to secure the first tranche. If Redwood needs OEM introductions for contract terms, we are open to a tri-party MSA.

Attachment: omnigpu_quick-quote_Q3.pdf (PDF, 34KB)

Best,
Tim Chen
Strategic Accounts, OmniGPU

From: ben_carter <ben@redwood.ai>
To: karthik_iyer <karthik@redwood.ai>, lauren_bishop <lauren@redwood.ai>, naomi_feldman <naomi@redwood.ai>
Cc: Alicia Park <alicia@acme.ai>
Date: 2025-08-23T10:15:00-07:00
Subject: CloudEx burst option and cost runway

Team / Alicia — I pinged CloudEx and pulled a provisional run-rate for burst capacity that would match a 200 A100-equivalent footprint. Key points: 
- Cold start to capacity: 48–72 hours for reserved pool activation (need customer auth and billing link).
- Sustained cost: roughly 1.8x hosted API cost per-token converted to per-GPU-hour for short-term (we provided an estimate sheet to Alicia).
- Minimum engagement: monthly; we can negotiate a 30-day trial credit to cover the first month while OEM hardware ships.

Operational notes: we should template a three-part runbook to give Acme and procurement:
1) Immediate: CloudEx reserved burst for first 60–90 days (activate within 72h).
2) Near-term: split OEM shipments (100 + 100) to avoid customs single-batch delays.
3) Long-term: transition to Dedicated pool with pinned model/quantization configs; Redwood handles KV caching to reduce required peak GPUs.

I will draft the runbook and cost comparison tab in the sizer spreadsheet and share.

—Ben
Head of Solutions, Redwood Inference
[Attachment referenced: cloudex_cost_estimate.csv]

From: karthik_iyer <karthik@redwood.ai>
To: Alicia Park <alicia@acme.ai>, Tim Chen <tim.chen@omnigpu.com>, ben_carter <ben@redwood.ai>
Cc: lauren_bishop <lauren@redwood.ai>, naomi_feldman <naomi@redwood.ai>
Date: 2025-08-25T16:03:00-07:00
Subject: RE: Dedicated capacity sizing: alignment on ETA, quotes, and cloud fallback

Alicia — thanks everyone for quick turn. Collating decisions for Acme procurement: 

1) Proposal to procurement committee (what to include):
- Scenario A (Accelerated): 200 GPUs via OmniGPU tranche 1 (PO + 30% deposit) => ship ETA ~14 weeks; CloudEx burst for 90 days to cover ramp; total near-term cost = [see sheet].
- Scenario B (Conservative): staggered purchase with 100/100 split, longer payment terms, CloudEx for 120 days.
- Scenario C (Hybrid commit): smaller immediate OEM commit + higher CloudEx usage, then finalize OEM tranche 2 after production confirmation.

2) Action items:
- Tim: please confirm deposit terms and include a two-batch shipping plan in the PDF (due EOD 2025-08-27).
- Ben: finalize cloud burst cost sheet and include a 30-day trial credit option (due 2025-08-26).
- Lauren/Naomi: I will prepare a one-page runbook and an exec summary for Acme's procurement packet (draft by 2025-08-26).

Alicia — if the committee wants, we can run a short joint call (30 min) this week to walk through scenarios. Proposed slots: 2025-08-26 10:00-10:30 or 2025-08-26 15:00-15:30 PDT.

Thanks,
Karthik
Senior Sales, Redwood Inference
